units.known_address_notes: ABDK report (2024) reviews a Solidity 'BlockchainVerifier' for =nil; Foundation, a verifier-library component used by nil's zkSharding/EVM contracts, not a standalone deployed protocol. No deployment address is published in the report, nil docs (docs.nil.foundation) or the NilFoundation org; GitHub code search for 'BlockchainVerifier' returns no NilFoundation repo. Endpoint chain is =nil;'s own L2, which is not in the traceable explorer set.

units.titles: User’s fund can be transferred out without consent
units.known_address_notes: Zokyo audit (2023-01-02) of 'OT' contracts FlashLoan.sol, VariableBorrow.sol, Curve.sol, Liquidity.sol, Osd.sol, Swap.sol from repo https://github.dev/1kxexchange/1kx-v1 at commit 54f4b95f372ab4176eea16cdb7e51571ff7c393. The GitHub repo 1kxexchange/1kx-v1 is 404 (deleted/private) and the report names no deployment network or address; the 'OT' label is an abbreviation only, so identity of the live protocol could not be tied to an on-chain instance.
